items.text: ETR Sunday injury designations: IN Puka Nacua, Nico Collins, D'Andre Swift, Bucky Irving, Tony Pollard; QUESTIONABLE Ladd McConkey, Zay Flowers, Terry McLaurin, Mike Evans; OUT Justin Jefferson, Breece Hall, DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Jadarian Price, De'Von Achane, Jayden Daniels, Caleb Williams and others.
items.why: Official final designations compiled by ETR
items.implication: Major role changes and start/sit pivots across multiple teams
items.opportunity: Snap/target spikes for backups and remaining skill players

items.text: Players out for Sunday include ... Breece Hall ...
items.implication: Jets RB committee shifts fully to backups
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry opportunity for remaining RBs

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Eagles passing game depleted with Goedert also out
items.opportunity: Targets to Wicks and remaining WRs/TEs

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.why: Sprained ankle from Week 3; missed practice
items.implication: Major WR1 absence opens targets elsewhere

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; some speculation he could have snaps limited, we'll see.
items.why: Hip injury recovery; full practice clearance implied
items.implication: WR1 upside restored but volume risk if limited
items.opportunity: Routes and targets vs Eagles secondary weakened by absences

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. DvP has Cowboys inflating opposing WR scoring by 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.why: Hamstring cleared; elite matchup data + high implied total
items.implication: Elite WR1 ceiling in favorable game script
items.opportunity: High target share vs inflated Cowboys WR DVP

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs. a borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson OUT creates target vacuum vs weak secondary
items.implication: WR2/3 with WR1 upside this week
items.opportunity: Elevated target share and red-zone looks

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Will be without three of their most important players vs. Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.why: Multiple key absences on offense and defense
items.implication: Hurts and remaining pass-catchers face tougher outlook; Rams offense boosted
items.opportunity: Increased target concentration on remaining Eagles weapons; Nacua/Adams upside

items.text: De'Von Achane listed OUT (along with Caleb Douglas).
items.why: Season-ending ACL tear suffered in Week 3
items.implication: Miami backfield fully opens for committee
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, red-zone for remaining RBs

items.text: Kyle Shanahan said WR Mike Evans, who is dealing with a rib injury, will be a game-time decision.
items.why: Ribs; intends to play through with padding per reports
items.implication: Monitor pre-game; Kittle upside if limited/out

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass work to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet back at practice. Passes eye test longer-term but role eroded; now OUT.
items.implication: Seattle RB hierarchy shifting; Price long-term still viable
items.opportunity: Goal-line and pass-down snaps to others

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
items.why: Back injury cleared; full practice/no designation
items.implication: QB1 locked in with dual-threat upside

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE as top-10 play: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
items.why: Workhorse role with Dowdle out + favorable matchup
items.opportunity: Near-full snap share, carries, potential targets

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%, only 13% third downs; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
items.why: Declining usage + tough run defense matchup
